name: How long does a head injury claim take to resolve in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How long does a head injury claim take to resolve in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a head injury claim in San Diego can vary significantly based on factors like the severity of the injury, the complexity of the case, and the willingness of all parties to negotiate. Simple cases might resolve in several months through settlement, while more complex cases involving extensive medical treatment or litigation can take a year or more. Your lawyer can provide a more accurate estimate after reviewing your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Resolution time for a head injury claim in San Diego varies, from several months for simple cases to over a year for complex ones.
